intro: The Salty Sailor Tavern is the beating heart of Booty Bay's social life, serving as the port's primary inn and watering hole. Run by the goblin Innkeeper Skindle, it welcomes scoundrels, mercenaries, and travelers from both factions seeking respite from the perils of the jungle.

sections.t: A Safe Haven in the Jungle
p: Perched amidst the wooden tiers of Booty Bay, the Salty Sailor Tavern offers warm beds and strong drinks under the watchful eye of the Blackwater Raiders. Behind the bar stands Innkeeper Skindle, keeping glasses filled while a menagerie of buccaneers, traders, and adventurers mingle on neutral ground. Outside the establishment hangs a massive, curious curio—a Zul'Gurub Protector Stone—serving as a strange trophy in this bustling den of commerce.
